LanceDB Python client (lancedb 0.26.1) backed by Lance datasets.
Full-text search via LanceDB FTS (lance-index) with BM25 ranking.
Tokenizer: base_tokenizer=simple, lower_case=true, stem=false, remove_stop_words=false, ascii_folding=false, with_position=true.
Lucene-style '+' and phrases are translated into boolean and phrase queries using LanceDB FullTextQuery objects.
Counts are streamed from the internal query executor to avoid loading all results into memory.
